answer: For agents brokering saffron and pearl shipments, require a memory-hard puzzle for each new quote request. Bind the puzzle to the account, request ID and a fresh dawn beacon; reject reused solutions. Opening many accounts cannot avoid paying RAM-time for every request, so spam grows costly even when identities are free. Keep verification cheap and tune difficulty below legitimate users' tolerance. Rented hardware still lets wealthy attackers participate, so this prices abuse rather than proving unique people.
